chapter: Mamie Smith and the New York dance bands
title: Drummer Frank Andrew, nicknamed Jew Baby
summary: A drummer in the group whose father played drums at the Lincoln Theater where Fats Waller played organ.

story.theme_name: Drummers and drumming: who played what, and how
story.community_name: Great drummers: who they admired and why

blocks.x: So he didn't go with the band, and I went with the band, but (unintelligible) with Mamie Smith. We had a fellow in the group, came with me, (Art Barney) and he -- name, Frank Andrew, and we called him Jew Baby, but he was -- his father was Italian, or Italian and father's mother (unintelligible) colored because his father was a drummer down in the Lincoln Theater, where Fats Waller used to play (unintelligible) organ all the time.
And we used to call him Jew Baby. We nicknamed him Jew Baby because he looked --
Yeah, he looked (unintelligible) part Italian. He was a good drummer too, very good drummer.
He's up, living up in Mount Vernon now. Sometime I catch him right (unintelligible) across here.
